en:
Motonari's campaign to unify Aki
came to a close with the Kikkawa
and Takeda still on the Amago side.



Though he had extended his power,
he was not yet able to stand up to
the Amago, and for the time being
his dream of uniting Aki was shelved.


And so several years went by.
A third son, Tokujumaru, was born to
the Mouri; Ouchi Yoshioki died and
Yoshitaka became clan head; and
Takeda Nobushige succeeded his
brother Mitsukazu, killed in battle.
The time was ripe, and the West was
about to stir mightily once again...

Wed Kunishi Motosuke
Wed Kodama Naritada
